name: Fuse
summary: An overcurrent protective element that interrupts a circuit by melting its fuse link.
description: A fuse representation identifies a protective fuse link in a circuit. Its rating and operating characteristics are additional information: a generic fuse mark does not specify utilization category, current, voltage, breaking capacity or coordination with other protective equipment.

Fuses appear in main power circuits, transformer circuits and control supplies. Some assemblies add indication or auxiliary contacts. A drawing should distinguish the protective link from the holder, disconnect mechanism and any indication function.
readingNotes: Follow the protected circuit and identify how many fuse links are represented.
Treat associated indication contacts as separate schematic elements.
drawingChecklist: Reference the fuse type and rating.
Identify the holder or fuse-switch assembly when relevant.
Keep auxiliary indication and replacement information linked.
distinction: A fuse and a fused disconnector may share protective components, but the assembly also includes a switching or isolation function.
